tokens.name: surface-ivory
tokens.usage: Primary background. Use instead of stark white everywhere practical — the dominant light neutral across the identity.

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Logo, primary typography, structural elements, navigation, presentation/proposal covers. Should read clearly as blue, not black.

tokens.name: slate-blue
tokens.usage: Supporting blue. Secondary hierarchy, diagrams, interface components, secondary text, understated backgrounds.

tokens.name: cool-gray
tokens.usage: Dividers, tables, charts, structural rules, secondary information, quiet interface elements. Decorative use only — not for body text (fails contrast on ivory).

tokens.name: soft-gray
tokens.usage: Subtle backgrounds, forms, tables, panels, understated structural areas.

tokens.name: deep-plum
tokens.usage: Accent only, sparingly: short rules, page numbers, small highlights, section markers, data emphasis, occasional links. Never a primary background or the default CTA color. Reads as a deep, sophisticated plum — not red, burgundy, maroon, cranberry, or wine. Should feel like a deliberate discovery, never competing with navy as the primary color, and never romantic, feminine, or dramatic in tone.

styles.name: display-headline
styles.usage: Major display headline. Large scale, generous vertical space around it. Reserve for high-impact moments.

styles.name: section-headline
styles.usage: Section headline when the section should feel editorial or significant. Use Body/subhead instead for functional sections.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes and selected editorial statements.

styles.name: large-numeral
styles.usage: Large numerals — especially the LOFT Blueprint's 01–05 sequence.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Primary body copy — website, proposals, presentations, contracts, descriptive and informational content. Comfortable line spacing; never compressed into dense blocks.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Subheads, emphasis within body copy, functional hierarchy, table headings, important labels. Medium or Demi Bold only — never let heavy sans dominate the identity.

styles.name: functional-headline
styles.usage: Section headline when the section is functional rather than editorial (use Display/section-headline for editorial sections).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow text, section identifiers, short uppercase labels, small category names. Avenir Next Condensed Light only — generous tracking (0.15em+), never for paragraph-length copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Fine structural spacing — rule offsets, tight internal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Standard internal padding, gaps between related elements.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Generous page margins, space around the logo lockup.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between major page sections — authority through negative space, not just air.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. LOFT prefers square corners over rounded ones.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle softening only when functionally necessary (e.g. form inputs). Never pill shapes; avoid heavy rounding as a primary motif.
